files.purpose: New at B3 (status A, 124 lines): two value-type helpers extracted from the B2 bodies of PiSession, CommandCodeSession and AntigravitySession so the three CLI provider adapters share one copy. EditSnapshots (lines 3-41) holds, per tool-call id, the text of a file as it stood when an edit/write call started and turns it into the finished before-against-after FileEdit; StreamedTextTracker (lines 43-124) mints per-launch message and thinking ids from provider-supplied formatter closures and accumulates the streamed reply and reasoning text for one turn. Neither type performs I/O except EditSnapshots.read, which reads a file of at most 1_000_000 bytes as UTF-8.
key_symbols: mutating func capture(_ id: String, path: String)
mutating func finish(_ id: String, path: String, relativeTo root: String) -> [FileEdit]?
private static func read(_ path: String) -> String?
mutating func appendMessage(_ delta: String) -> String
mutating func appendThinking(_ delta: String, resetsText: Bool = true) -> String
calls_into: FileEdit(path:) and FileEdit(path:old:new:) (Core timeline model; SessionSupport.swift:31-32)
state_owned: EditSnapshots.contents: map of tool-call id -> file text captured at call start ("" when the read yields nil)
StreamedTextTracker.messageCounter / thinkingCounter: per-session (never reset per turn) counters fed to the id closures
StreamedTextTracker.currentMessageID / currentThinkingID: the open reply and reasoning block ids
StreamedTextTracker.streamedText: whether any text delta arrived since the last startMessage/resetForTurn
side_effects: File read (size probe then UTF-8 decode) in EditSnapshots.capture and EditSnapshots.finish via read(_:); no writes, no events emitted directly
platform_assumptions: URLResourceValues.fileSize for the 1 MB ceiling (size <= 1_000_000); a missing file, a directory or any resourceValues failure yields nil, which capture stores as "" and finish treats as an empty after-text
String(contentsOf:encoding:.utf8) fails (nil) on non-UTF-8 content, so binary files read as empty
Swift String != at line 31 is Unicode canonical-equivalence comparison, not code-unit comparison
feature_notes: SOURCE FACT: the file does not exist at B2 (git diff 1fbf81e6..HEAD shows 124 insertions; git grep of B2 finds no EditSnapshots or StreamedTextTracker). Its code is a line-for-line extraction of B2 logic: EditSnapshots.read = B2 AntigravitySession.swift:269-273 / CommandCodeSession.swift:642-646 / PiSession.swift:496-500 (Self.snapshot); EditSnapshots.finish = B2 AntigravitySession.swift:259-265 and CommandCodeSession.swift:631-638 (finishEdit); StreamedTextTracker = B2 CommandCodeSession.swift:44-50,293-318,325-337,438-439,139 and PiSession.swift:39-42,310-316,349-365,393-401.

SOURCE FACT: B3 users: PiSession.swift:39,52,63-66 (ids "<launchID>-m-<n>" / "<launchID>-t-<n>"), 187, 297-298 (startMessage + resetThinking), 333, 336 (appendThinking default resetsText true), 356-372, 384, 450-451; CommandCodeSession.swift:43,49,78 (ids "cc-<launchID>-m<n>" / "cc-<launchID>-r<n>"), 139-140, 294-321 (appendThinking resetsText: false), 352-354, 375, 422 (resetIDs), 604, 679; AntigravitySession.swift:47,232,261,284 (EditSnapshots only; Antigravity keeps its own streamedText).

SOURCE FACT: the doc comment at :86-87 records the one per-provider fork: when a thinking delta arrives with no open id, Pi (resetsText true) empties thinkingText, Command Code (resetsText false) keeps it; this matches B2 PiSession.swift:359-362 and CommandCodeSession.swift:313-316 exactly.

ENGINEERING DECISION (analysis): no observable behaviour changes at B3. Checked each difference: (a) CommandCodeSession now passes editSnapshots.text(id) ("" when absent) where B2 passed the optional editSnapshots[id]; makeToolCall's only use is `snapshot ?? ""` (B3 :548, B2 :577), so the FileEdit is identical. (b) B3 finishEdit in CC/Antigravity checks the path before EditSnapshots.finish removes the entry, whereas B2 removed first; with no path both return nil and the orphaned B3 entry is dropped by removeAll at the next turn/result, never read. (c) startMessage/appendMessage also set streamedText for Pi, which never reads it. (d) PiSession write diff uses text(id)+discard(id) = B2 removeValue(forKey:) ?? "".

Why it matters for the port: every provider record describing snapshots, finishEdit, lazy id minting or thinking-block accumulation for Pi, Command Code and Antigravity now has its implementing lines here, so those records need SessionSupport.swift cited, and the one-Swift-file-per-unit plan needs a new unit for this file.
